texts.title: 课文一：找饭店
texts.setting: 李文在找饭店，王一飞给他打电话。

lines.speaker: 王一飞
lines.hanzi: 喂，李文，你什么时候能到饭店？
lines.pinyin: Wèi, Lǐ Wén, nǐ shénme shíhou néng dào fàndiàn?
lines.english: Hello, Li Wen. When can you get to the restaurant?

lines.speaker: 李文
lines.hanzi: 还不知道，正在找呢。它是不是在超市后边？
lines.pinyin: Hái bù zhīdào, zhèngzài zhǎo ne. Tā shì bu shì zài chāoshì hòubian?
lines.english: I don't know yet. I'm looking for it. Is it behind the supermarket?

lines.speaker: 王一飞
lines.pinyin: Shì de. Nǐ kāichē méi kāichē?
lines.english: Yes. Are you driving or not?

lines.speaker: 李文
lines.pinyin: Wǒ méi kāichē, zuò chē ne.
lines.english: I'm not driving. I'm taking a car.

texts.title: 课文二：读大学
texts.setting: 王一飞和李文在饭店聊天儿。

lines.speaker: 王一飞
lines.pinyin: Nǐ hái zài dú dàxué ma?
lines.english: Are you still studying at university?

lines.speaker: 李文
lines.hanzi: 对，我读大学呢，还是大学生。
lines.pinyin: Duì, wǒ dú dàxué ne, hái shì dàxuéshēng.
lines.english: Yes, I'm studying at university, and I'm still a university student.

lines.speaker: 李文
lines.hanzi: 非常忙，我学医，我们的课很多。
lines.pinyin: Fēicháng máng, wǒ xué yī, wǒmen de kè hěn duō.
lines.english: Very busy. I study medicine, and we have many classes.

texts.title: 课文三：还在睡觉
texts.setting: 星期六早上，刘明出门前和女儿对话。

lines.speaker: 刘明
lines.english: Has your younger brother gotten up?

lines.speaker: 刘小雪
lines.pinyin: Méi qǐchuáng ne, hái zài shuìjiào.

lines.speaker: 刘明
lines.hanzi: 还睡觉呢？他今天去不去那里？
lines.pinyin: Hái shuìjiào ne? Tā jīntiān qù bu qù nàli?
lines.english: Still sleeping? Is he going there today?

lines.speaker: 刘小雪
lines.hanzi: 我昨天问他，他对我说，他不去，他今天要和小朋友玩。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān wèn tā, tā duì wǒ shuō, tā bú qù, tā jīntiān yào hé xiǎopéngyǒu wán.
lines.english: I asked him yesterday. He told me he isn't going. Today he is going to play with kids.

g_l11_02.title: 时间副词“在/正在”
g_l11_02.structure: 在/正在 + 动词 + 呢
g_l11_02.english: 在/正在 marks an action in progress.
g_l11_02.russian: 在/正在 показывает действие в процессе.

formula.pattern: 在/正在 + 动词 + 呢

g_l11_03.title: 能愿动词“要”
g_l11_03.english: 要 before a verb means want to or be going to do something.
g_l11_03.russian: 要 перед глаголом означает хотеть или собираться сделать что-то.
